name: pullover-barbell-decline-wide-grip
title: Pullover: Barbell (Decline, Wide Grip)
primer: This is an advanced strengthening exercise which targets the pectoral or chest muscles.
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your feet higher than your head and hooked under the foot pads.
Grasp the barbell with an extra wide grip (your hands near the plates) and starting at your upper thighs, raise the barbell in an arc over your head towards the floor.
Slowly return the barbell to the starting position on your thighs.
tips: Ensure your back and hips remain in contact with the bench at all times.
